long_biography.plain_text:
Haycox entered business through his father's struggling uniform company, then moved into bars and adult-entertainment venues. He expanded rapidly with borrowed money, but the operation failed during the financial crisis and he was declared bankrupt. That experience became central to the business-finance advice he later offered to entrepreneurs.

He established Funding Guru as a lender and finance adviser for smaller companies, and joined an early-stage investment programme as a capital provider. He also built a public platform around interviews, podcasts and practical business guidance. He was declared bankrupt again in 2025, and a High Court later granted summary judgment against him in a lending dispute.
